operation: offline analysis of existing real H0 recording

clock.note: ROS header, kernel CAN and SDK times are retained separately; none is asserted to be exposure time

association_limits_ms.meaning: caller-selected data association limits, not verified hardware latency limits

limitations: Receive association is not exposure synchronization or sensor latency.
H0 periodic PNG samples are sparse; most timing rows may have no raw image file.
Annotated preview.avi is not used as raw RGB.
No action labels are inferred from measured states or historical motion events.
CameraInfo, intrinsics and extrinsics remain source metadata, not newly calibrated values.
No original PNG bytes were downloaded for this analysis; zero complete model observations is intentional and must not be relabeled as an export/inference success.
The short old motion-window RGB excerpt contains receive bursts and has a different duration from the arm excerpts; its receive_hz is not a current camera performance claim.
Historical wrist mount describes this source session only; the current camera mounting choice must be recorded explicitly.
analysis_scope: historical offline analysis of a real 2026-11-16 H0 motion-window excerpt, performed 2026-11-20; not a current hardware acceptance result
